title: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
claim: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
why_good: TurboFieldfare is a Swift/Metal runtime that runs Gemma 4 26B-A4B in ~2GB RAM by streaming experts from SSD. It provides a native Mac app, CLI, and OpenAI-compatible server, achieving 5-35 tok/s on M2/M5.
value: Developers and AI enthusiasts with 8GB Macs pay for a native app that lets them run Gemma 4 locally for private, offline experimentation.
risk: Apple's next Macs may have more RAM, and cloud providers offer free tiers, reducing the need for local inference.

voices.quote: Nice. Gemma feels nice to write with but every time I use it for coding it struggles with tool calling significantly.

does: TurboFieldfare is a Swift/Metal runtime that runs Gemma 4 26B-A4B in ~2GB RAM by streaming experts from SSD. It provides a native Mac app, CLI, and OpenAI-compatible server, achieving 5-35 tok/s on M2/M5.
why_use: It's the only way to run a 26B model on 8GB Macs without cloud, and it's open-source. Users complain that other models struggle with tool calling; Gemma 4 here is instruction-tuned and runs locally.
gap: Runs a capable model on low-RAM Macs but lacks a polished consumer product around it.
counter: Apple could add more unified memory to base Macs, or MLX/llama.cpp could add similar SSD streaming, making this a niche feature. Also, cloud APIs are easier for most.
differentiator: Package TurboFieldfare as a one-click installer with a friendly UI for non-technical Mac users, and add a curated model zoo.
hook: Mac users with 8GB RAM who want to run a 26B-parameter model locally but are locked out by memory-hungry runtimes.

zh.claim: 开源引擎，在任意 M 系列 Mac 上以 2 GB 内存运行 Gemma 4 26B
zh.hook: 拥有 8GB 内存的 Mac 用户，想要本地运行 26B 参数模型，但被内存占用高的运行时拒之门外。
zh.does: TurboFieldfare 是一个 Swift/Metal 运行时，通过从 SSD 流式加载专家，在约 2GB 内存中运行 Gemma 4 26B-A4B。提供原生 Mac 应用、CLI 和 OpenAI 兼容服务器，在 M2/M5 上实现 5-35 tok/s。
zh.why_use: 它是在 8GB Mac 上无需云即可运行 26B 模型的唯一方式，且开源。用户抱怨其他模型在工具调用上表现不佳；这里的 Gemma 4 经过指令微调，可本地运行。
zh.gap: 只有极客能用：需要从源码构建，要求 macOS 26，手动下载模型。没有面向普通用户的完善产品。
zh.counter: 苹果可能增加基础 Mac 的统一内存，或 MLX/llama.cpp 可能添加类似的 SSD 流式传输，使其成为小众功能。此外，云 API 对大多数人来说更容易。
zh.differentiator: 将 TurboFieldfare 打包成一键安装程序，为非技术 Mac 用户提供友好界面，并添加精选模型库。
zh.value: 拥有 8GB Mac 的开发者和 AI 爱好者付费购买原生应用，以便在本地私下离线运行 Gemma 4 进行实验。
zh.risk: 苹果下一代 Mac 可能增加内存，云服务商提供免费额度，降低本地推理的需求。
zh.why_good: TurboFieldfare 是一个 Swift/Metal 运行时，通过从 SSD 流式加载专家，在约 2GB 内存中运行 Gemma 4 26B-A4B。提供原生 Mac 应用、CLI 和 OpenAI 兼容服务器，在 M2/M5 上实现 5-35 tok/s。

consumer_angle: Ordinary Mac users can run a powerful local AI without buying new hardware.
pick_reason: Verified pain from HN comments, but the gap is technical and the wedge is unclear for non-technical users.
